    Infant & Toddler

    A Nurturing Start for
    Your Child’s First Years
    Ages 3–36 Months

    The first three years are filled with extraordinary growth.

    At Kai Ming, our Early Head Start classrooms provide infants and toddlers with warm, responsive care in environments where they can feel safe, build trusting relationships, explore, and learn.

    Our teachers follow each child’s individual routines, interests, and developmental needs while partnering closely with families.

    Learning Begins From the Very Beginning

    Relationships & Emotional Security

    Consistent, caring relationships help children feel safe, develop trust, express emotions, and begin building relationships with others.

    Exploration & Thinking

     

    Children learn by touching, moving, observing, repeating, experimenting, and discovering cause and effect.

    Early Language

     

    Teachers talk, sing, read, respond to sounds and gestures, and encourage children to communicate in ways appropriate to their developmental stage.

    Movement & Independence

    From reaching and crawling to walking, feeding themselves, drawing, and managing simple routines, children gradually build physical skills and independence.

    Care That Follows Your Child

    Every child develops differently. Our teachers observe each child closely and adapt activities, routines, and interactions to support their individual stage of development.

    ​

    Small teacher-child ratios also allow educators to build meaningful relationships and provide individualized attention. Kai Ming currently lists ratios of 1:3 for infants and 1:4 for toddlers.
